plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to meet concentration limits and reduce exposure.

conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged ETFs and exiting weak positions. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to comply with concentration limits.

This plan balances growth potential with a focus on risk management.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% per month by managing risk-first growth. It reduces leverage and concentration while maintaining some exposure to growth sectors. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month by leaning into leverage and concentration. It carries significantly higher risk, including larger potential drawdowns and leveraged ETF decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Add to QQQI to increase income-generating exposure.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month by focusing on yield and low drawdown. It prioritizes steady distributions, but NAV can still fall in market downturns. This is not a savings account.
